hypothesis: Temporary selling pressure can move price below its short-term equilibrium; buying after a large negative intraday shock may capture a reversal sufficient to cover costs.
economic_failure_conditions: Negative shocks continue rather than reverse
Reversal is too small to cover costs
entry_rule: 15-minute log close return <= -2 * sqrt(15) * sample standard deviation of the preceding 60 one-minute log returns, excluding the 15-minute shock. Require all 76 closes contiguous within the same New York session. No fitting or threshold search.
entry_price_assumption: next available minute open; reject missing expected timestamps rather than fill them
exit_rule: fixed horizon at minute open, with no trade crossing the session cutoff
quote_stress: add the previously observed 32.58272830737331 bps one-way quote scenario; diagnostic only, not calibrated fill evidence
retrospective_independence_warning: These dates may have been used in prior project research; they are generalization diagnostics, not a certified untouched final test. This hypothesis was chosen after a failed continuation study on these same dates; results are explicitly exploratory.

acceptance.uncertainty_method: Paired five-session block bootstrap; 12 simultaneous bounds conservatively include the prior four horizons and these two, two metrics per horizon. Does not correct unknown earlier project searches.

decision_rules.retire: Close each supported variant that fails the fixed criteria. Close under-supported trials as inconclusive; no parameter expansion.
decision_rules.revise: some evidence survives but coverage, stability, cost robustness, or execution reconciliation remains inadequate; record a new hypothesis before another experiment
decision_rules.continue: a frozen winner passes retrospective criteria and subsequent untouched confirmation with independently adequate execution evidence

stopping_rule: Evaluate the two fixed horizons once on retrospective data. Close both trials after reporting; do not lower support, cost, or significance thresholds. Future holdout stays unused.
data_policy: verify source content hashes and recompute AAPL calendar completeness; retain the older parent dataset failure and per-symbol quality distinction; overlapping timestamps use the dataset with the latest acquisition end date and conflicting closes are counted
execution_policy: artifact-only reconciliation; no new orders or promotion to manufacture evidence
